description: This script automates the building process of various interface components using CMake for a project related to RDK Management. It sets up environment variables, navigates the directory structure, and runs multiple CMake commands to generate build files for different targets such as audiodecoder, audiosink, avbuffer, and others.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The script's main logic which sets variables, changes directory, and executes CMake commands for various targets.
